scope: Physically check the existing AutoCAD 2007 metric FIELD roots against the exact-source ODA DXF and ACadSharp readback; do not modify DWG parsing.

peers.oda: File Converter 27.10 Linux ACAD2007 ASCII DXF, SHA-256 69ac93f16d7895e44e48448a25de60378be8af8d1fc7a36764da8feb33cbe989; original source/output binding in docs/research/p5-ac1021-general-value-oda-dxf-comparison-2026-11-25.json.
peers.acadsharp: ACadSharp revision 3a52a52047e84670759c1f9ad3916ec3ce85ff56, assembly SHA-256 99f24d71403ecdbda2272473ebd995d5d2e773b4a6e887bcdb404293cbf18b77. Existing FIELD probe adapted in scratch to include both AcObjProp evaluator IDs; built for net10 and run under .NET 11 with DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major.

proof.scope: decompressed object-local bits and peer output, not native behavior

observations: The bounded raw-frame extractor returned 162 FIELD frames. ODA selection identifies 42 roots with the tested ObjectPropertyId and ObjectPropertyName profile: 19 AcObjProp and 23 AcObjProp.16.2.

For all 42, an independent bit walker finds the selected child flags/type at object-local bit 287, a 32-byte UTF-16LE UpdatedDistance plus NUL payload beginning at bit 309, and the following BL zero ending exactly at bit 567, the framed body boundary.
All 42 have the checked relative owner token and two code-4 soft-pointer targets; these match ODA group-330/group-331 links and ACadSharp reported property strings and FIELD object targets.

A prior source-distinct imperial drawing with the same AutoCAD 2007 producer has 42 corresponding physical spans and peer observations; see docs/research/p5-ac1021-acobjprop-inline-string-physical-source-spans-2026-11-03.json.
validation: The reused generated frame self-test rejects count, payload, handle and truncation mutations. The metric checker also refuses a changed peer target, altered ACadSharp value and bad peer digest.
No drawing fixtures or derivative DXFs are committed.
authorityConflict: ODA specification v5.4.1 sections 2, 20.1, 20.4.76 and 20.4.99 describe type-4 CadValue as TV and require R2007+ Unicode text in the object string stream. The observed byte-count/payload sequence occupies the body. Under repository instructions the specification remains authoritative: the experiment does not authorize treating this sequence as a general inline-TV exception or completing these FIELD records.
limitations: Both drawings are from the same identified AutoCAD 2007 producer profile; cross-producer and native evaluator/round-trip validity remain unproved.
ACadSharp and ODA are readers/exporters of the same source; their agreement does not resolve the specification conflict or prove lossless preservation of the complete field.
This covers 42 of the 66 raw-only metric FIELD records, not the remaining 24, FIELDLIST whole-source output, or graph/native application semantics.
